newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy industrial output seen +1.2 pct in Q2 - Istat.
newsitem.headline: Italy industrial output seen +1.2 pct in Q2 - Istat.

text.p: Italian industrial production is expected to rise an unadjusted 1.2 percent in the second quarter by comparison with the first quarter, when output fell 0.9 percent, the president of statistics office Istat said.

Alberto Zuiliano told a parliamentary budget committee that the increase in output was forecast to be especially marked for investment goods, which were seen growing by more than two percent quarter-on-quarter.
Official April industrial production figures are due on June 13, with May data being published on July 16. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
